notes.title: Minor steam deck compatibility improvement
notes.notes: Various in-game videos (in the tutorial, and "Techniques" screen) did not play back properly on Steam Deck.  This has been fixed in this build!

notes.title: Version 2.2 Released!
notes.notes:
Version 2.2 of Very Very Valet is now available for Windows and Mac.

This patch adds support for 2 new langauges: Brazilian Portuguese and Polish
It also has some revisions to controller button/joystick images, and other bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Input Improvements Patch (2.1.3)
notes.notes:
We have updated Very Very Valet with some input improvements:

[olist]
[*] Player 1 can now use only the keyboard (no joystick).  So if you have 1 fewer controller than players, one player can use the keyboard now!  Previously this was not possible, because disabling a controller for Player 1 wasn't allowed.
[*] Input prompts now detect the connected controllers, and show the correct prompts for the connected controller type. Special button glyphs exist for Xbox, Playstation, and Nintendo Switch controllers.
[/olist]

Please note that the game uses XInput for Xbox/Microsoft controllers, and XInput has a limitation of 4 controllers connected at once.  To play with more than 4 players, we recommend using up to 4 Xbox controllers, and then other controller types (Dualshock, Joycons, etc) to fill out the other players.

notes.title: Version 2.1.2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed some achievements that were not unlocking properly
[*] Fixed a rare crash when the "embiggen" special was activated
[*] Fixed placement of bumpers on sporty car type to give them more clearance
[*] The score UI will politely fade out when an active customer or car timer is underneath it now.
[*] Fixed the launchers on "Observatory" to be more reliable regardless of framerate
[*] Revised "Seismic Stories" to make trampolines more reliable
[*] Revised "Sharing Spaces" to have a staircase on the right-hand side
[*] Revised "Downtown" slightly
[*] Made some improvements to replay playback speed under various refresh rates
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 2.1.1 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Fixes in this version:
[list]
[*] "Locked To Car" setting in party games now works when the "Off" option is selected
[*] Fixed some rude collision geometry in "Seismic Stories" level
[*] A rogue timer UI was appearing in strange places if the aspect ratio was changed after launching the game. It's in its proper place now.
[/list]
